text: The customer reported that their speaker from order LM-48870 arrived with a cracked cover and initially requested a refund. The previous agent mistakenly approved a full refund of ₹3,499 before retracting the offer, explaining that the unit was opened and used and therefore ineligible under the return policy. While frustrated by the mix-up, the customer agreed to accept a free replacement cover instead. Next, the replacement cover needs to be arranged and shipped to the customer.
